messages:
Priya R. (CSM): kicking off onboarding/activation plan for Sigma — thanks everyone for making time. goal: pilot live with production traffic within 5 weeks, handoff to success ops after 8 weeks. can we align owners and top risks?
Marcus L. (Solutions Eng): noted. i'll own SSO + rate-limit config. timeline looks tight but doable if infra checks finish this week.
Ava S. (Sigma): thanks Priya — from our side we need SSO + data residency confirmed before pilot. also want a 30-min enablement for our infra team.
Diego M. (Eng): @Ava noted on data residency. i need the region preference (eu-west-1 vs gcp-europe-west1) — which one do you want pinned?
Ava S. (Sigma): prefer eu-west-1.
Priya R. (CSM): ok eu-west-1 pinned. success criteria (proposed): 1) model endpoints serving <120ms p95 on pilot traffic, 2) SSO + RBAC enforced, 3) two runbooks delivered, 4) 3 internal users trained and doing end-to-end calls. any changes?
Tom B. (Product): add: baseline prompt eval pass rate >= 85% on the 20 eval prompts Sigma provided.
Marcus L. (Solutions Eng): i'll take runbooks and enablement with @Diego. propose two enablement sessions: 1) infra deep-dive, 2) dev integration walkthrough.
Priya R. (CSM): nice. proposed owners: Priya — program lead / weekly check-ins; Marcus — solutions owner (SSO, runbooks, enablement); Diego — infra / deployment; Tom — quality gating and evals. Ava — customer PM.
Jill (onboard-bot): Reminder: kickoff checklist created -> https://redwood.internal/onboard/SIGMA-001 (expires in 7 days) :spiral_calendar:
Ava S. (Sigma): thanks. quick Q: will we have dedicated capacity during pilot? budget approval still pending.
Priya R. (CSM): for pilot we can allocate a small dedicated pool (4 A100-equivalents) on a provisional basis. finance signoff needed for longer.
Diego M. (Eng): dependency: sigma needs to share IP allowlist on Monday. without that we can't open the VPC tunnel.
Ava S. (Sigma): we'll send the allowlist by Monday EOD.
Marcus L. (Solutions Eng): risk: renewal could be impacted if SSO integration slips >2 weeks. flagging as medium. mitigation: parallel workstreams — Marcus will do mock SSO tests with a dev tenant tomorrow.
Priya R. (CSM): timeline sketch (following weeks):
```
week 0: kickoff + infra region confirm + allowlist
week 1: SSO integration + dedicated pool provisioning
week 2: runbooks + initial enablement session
week 3: pilot traffic warmup + prompt evals
week 4: full pilot + metrics collection
week 5-8: optimization, roll to prod, handoff
```
Priya R. (CSM): please reply with any calendar conflicts. i'll schedule weekly 30m syncs (Thurs 11am PT) and ad-hoc technical sessions as needed.
Tom B. (Product): i'll review the 20 eval prompts and post baseline results by Friday.
Marcus L. (Solutions Eng): putting a placeholder for the infra deep-dive: Wed 10am PT. @Ava can you confirm an attendee?
Ava S. (Sigma): yes - i'll have our infra lead (Rohan) join. also want an item added: cost reporting cadence during pilot (daily token/cost so we can watch unit economics).
Priya R. (CSM): added. owner for cost dashboard = Priya + Marcus. we'll push a daily snapshot to the Sigma Slack channel.
Diego M. (Eng): technical note: if we enable KV cache for the pilot, we can reduce token cost ~25% for chat-heavy flows. need to confirm prompt patterns.
Ava S. (Sigma): good to know. we'll share sample traffic patterns (volume + avg length).
Priya R. (CSM): action items summary:
- Sigma -> share IP allowlist + sample traffic patterns (Ava) [due Mon EOD]
- Marcus -> mock SSO tests + runbooks draft [due Fri]
- Diego -> VPC tunnel + dedicated pool provisioning [due Fri]
- Tom -> eval baseline results [due Fri]
- Priya -> schedule recurring syncs + cost dashboard [due Tue]
Priya R. (CSM): closing note: if anything blocks owners, flag in this thread and i'll escalate. excited to get Sigma live :rocket:
